$comment: T0.5 — committed targets for the v2 refactor. Read by scripts (e.g., contract validators, codegen) so wrappers/codegen are designed for the end-state. Drift between this file and reality is a refactor smell.

rationale.decoratorMode: G7: never change build tooling and language semantics in the same step. Standard decorators are deferred to T7.1.
rationale.packageManager: User-confirmed pnpm over yarn 4 (stricter dep graph catches phantom deps).
rationale.vrtTool: User-confirmed Playwright (free, in-repo, runs in CI).
